Stack: React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + Supabase + React Query + Recharts + Framer Motion. Never use `any` type.

## Task: Sprint 1C — Dashboard Redesign as "Home Base"

The current dashboard at `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx` (665 lines) has KPI cards, charts, recent scans table, and quick wins. We're redesigning it to be the "home base" — more engaging, gamified, and action-oriented.

### Read these files first:
- `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx` — current dashboard implementation
- `src/hooks/use-dashboard-stats.ts` — current stats hook
- `src/components/shared/ScoreRing.tsx` — existing score ring component
- `src/components/shared/KpiCard.tsx` — existing KPI card component
- `src/types/index.ts` — types including DashboardStats

### New Components to Create:

**1. `src/components/dashboard/ScoreHealthHero.tsx`**
A hero section at the top of the dashboard:
- Large ScoreRing (120px diameter) showing overall average CRO score
- Health label next to it: "Excellent" (70+, green), "Needs Work" (40-69, amber), "Critical" (<40, red)
- Scan streak counter: "X scans this week" with a flame icon if streak > 3
- Brief greeting: "Good morning, {firstName}" (extract from profile.full_name)
- If no scans yet, show a "Run your first scan" CTA button linking to /scan
- Use `motion.div` from framer-motion for a fade-in entrance animation
- Use the existing `ScoreRing` component from `@/components/shared/ScoreRing`

**2. `src/components/dashboard/ActionItemsStrip.tsx`**
A horizontal strip showing top 3 unresolved critical findings:
- Each item is a compact card: severity dot (red/amber), finding title (truncated), "View" link to report
- If no critical findings, show a green "All clear" message
- Horizontal scroll on mobile, 3 columns on desktop
- Props: `items: Array<{ id: string; title: string; severity: string; scanId: string }>`

**3. `src/components/dashboard/MilestoneTracker.tsx`**
A gamification card showing CRO journey milestones:
- Milestones: "First Scan", "Score Above 50", "Score Above 70", "5 Scans", "10 Scans", "Score Above 85"
- Each milestone: icon/emoji, label, completed/locked state
- Show as a horizontal progress tracker with connected dots
- Green checkmark for completed, gray lock for locked
- Props: `totalScans: number; bestScore: number`

**4. `src/components/dashboard/ScoreTrendChart.tsx`**
An enhanced score trend chart:
- Use Recharts AreaChart (not LineChart) with gradient fill
- Show 8-week trend (or all available data points)
- Purple gradient fill matching primary color
- X-axis: dates, Y-axis: scores (0-100)
- Reference line at score 70 (labeled "Good")
- If less than 2 data points, show an EmptyState instead
- Props: `data: Array<{ date: string; score: number }>`

### Modify Dashboard.tsx:
Restructure the layout to this order:
1. ScoreHealthHero (full width)
2. ActionItemsStrip (full width, only show if there are critical findings)
3. KPI cards row (keep existing 4 cards + add "Score Change" showing delta from last week)
4. Two-column grid:
   - Left (2/3 width): ScoreTrendChart
   - Right (1/3 width): MilestoneTracker
5. Recent scans table (keep existing, full width)

### Modify use-dashboard-stats.ts:
Add these to the returned stats:
- `best_score: number` — highest score from any scan
- `scans_this_week: number` — scans created in the last 7 days
- `score_trend_data: Array<{ date: string; score: number }>` — weekly averages for the trend chart
- `critical_action_items: Array<{ id: string; title: string; severity: string; scanId: string }>` — top 3 unresolved critical findings from recent scans

Fetch these from the existing `scans` and `scan_results` tables using the Supabase client.

### Requirements:
- Use existing design tokens (primary color, shadows, etc.)
- All components use `motion.div` from framer-motion for staggered entrance
- Mobile-responsive (single column on mobile, grid on desktop)
- No `any` types
- Keep existing DashboardSkeleton or update it to match new layout
- Import new components and use them in Dashboard.tsx
